method.type: adversarial source-proof review and hand-verifiable mathematical direction selection
frozen_scope: do not reopen completed tree/cactus/SP reductions

uncertainty: The two-terminal bundle is raw-source eligible but is absorbed into terminal boundary under the source preprocessing; the four-terminal construction supplies a post-preprocessing check.
No asymptotic lower bound on joint representative families was proved.
The targeted external literature check does not prove a universal absence of a later arbitrary-tree approximation result.
next_falsifiable_action: Execute THEORY-PARALLEL-TOKEN-SWAPPING-TREE-APPROX-001 as a non-experimental theory task; first prove or refute the C+D schedule bound, and keep any result separate from Zero Extension.
mathematical_claim: The source's exact joint representative query is Gamma(X)\B, where Gamma requires simultaneous extension in all s gammoid layers and B is an arbitrary uniform-layer exclusion of size at most k-1. A candidate union-of-small-profiles bound would be sufficient but was not proved; deleting M0 or intersecting layer systems does not establish it.
assumptions: The source preprocessing and its distinction from the raw certificate ground set are respected.
All metrics are finite metrics and terminal labelings are injective.
Representative-family claims are kept separate from graph sparsifier and contraction claims.
verified_steps: The all-terminal K3 witness is invalid because E_S equals its edge set.
The two-terminal 3-2-3 parallel bundle gives the corrected raw M0-deletion witness, with both central edges essential under the stated discrete metric and budget.
Corollary 4.2 absorbs those central edges into the terminal boundary; this qualification is now explicit.
A four-terminal two-central-edge bundle with L>=3 has singleton furthest isolating cuts and retains two essential internal central edges under k=q=2L+2.
For any gammoid profile X and uniform exclusion B, direct-sum extension is exactly Gamma(X)\B.
If |Gamma(X)|<=k, setting B=Gamma(X)\{e} forces every e in Gamma(X) into any exact representative family.
No exchange axiom was obtained for the intersection of layer-wise extension systems.
gaps: Bound the union of all admissible Gamma profiles, or find a different reconstruction theorem.
Establish or refute a simultaneous exchange surrogate with explicit f(s) and universal k exponent.
Prove any conversion from a new certificate to a sequential contraction algorithm or arbitrary terminal-preserving sparsifier.
